mcqs.learning_point: सादगी और दिखावे के अंतर को समझना
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements reflects a common misconception about the difference between सादगी and दिखावा as portrayed in प्रेमचंद के फटे जूते?

options.A: सादगी का अर्थ है केवल बाहरी रूप में साधारण दिखना, जबकि दिखावा हमेशा भौतिक संपत्ति का अभाव दर्शाता है।
options.B: सादगी वह है जहाँ व्यक्ति अपने वास्तविक स्वभाव को बिना दिखावे के प्रस्तुत करता है; दिखावा वह है जहाँ व्यक्ति बाहरी रूप से धनी या महत्वपूर्ण दिखने की कोशिश करता है, चाहे वह वास्तविकता से मेल न खाए।
options.C: सादगी और दिखावा दोनों ही समान हैं; दोनों का उद्देश्य सामाजिक मान्यता प्राप्त करना है।
options.D: सादगी केवल गरीब लोगों की विशेषता है, जबकि दिखावा केवल अमीरों की।

mcqs.answer: सादगी वह है जहाँ व्यक्ति अपने वास्तविक स्वभाव को बिना दिखावे के प्रस्तुत करता है; दिखावा वह है जहाँ व्यक्ति बाहरी रूप से धनी या महत्वपूर्ण दिखने की कोशिश करता है, चाहे वह वास्तविकता से मेल न खाए।
mcqs.explanation: Option B correctly distinguishes सादगी (inner humility without pretence) from दिखावा (outward pretence of importance). The other options either equate the two, assign them to specific classes, or misinterpret सादगी as merely external simplicity, which is a misconception.

mcqs.learning_point: लेखक के व्यंग्यात्मक दृष्टिकोण को पहचानना
mcqs.question: How does प्रेमचंद employ व्यंग्य to critique societal attitudes towards appearance in फटे जूते?

options.A: He praises the worn‑out shoes as symbols of dignity.
options.B: He uses irony to show that society values outward appearance over inner worth.
options.C: He avoids any mention of appearance and focuses solely on economic poverty.
options.D: He uses humor to celebrate material wealth.

mcqs.answer: He uses irony to show that society values outward appearance over inner worth.
mcqs.explanation: The correct answer captures प्रेमचंद’s satirical technique: he presents the shabby shoes with a tone of irony, exposing the absurdity of judging people by looks. Options A, C and D misrepresent his intent, either praising poverty, ignoring appearance, or glorifying wealth, none of which align with his व्यंग्यात्मक दृष्टिकोण.

mcqs.learning_point: चित्र और पाठ के संबंध को समझना
mcqs.question: In प्रेमचंद के फटे जूते, how does the illustration relate to the accompanying text?

options.A: Both the illustration and the text emphasize the stark contrast between the worn‑out shoes and the dignified attitude of the wearer, reinforcing प्रेमचंद’s satire.
options.B: The illustration shows luxurious shoes, contradicting the text’s focus on poverty.
options.C: The illustration is unrelated to the theme and merely decorative.
options.D: The text describes a festive scene, while the illustration depicts a somber mood, creating confusion.

mcqs.answer: Both the illustration and the text emphasize the stark contrast between the worn‑out shoes and the dignified attitude of the wearer, reinforcing प्रेमचंद’s satire.
mcqs.explanation: Option A correctly notes that the picture of tattered shoes and the narrative’s description work together to highlight the gap between external appearance and inner virtue. The other options describe mismatches that do not exist in the story.

mcqs.learning_point: पाठ के निहित सामाजिक संदेश को समझना
mcqs.question: Which statement best captures the underlying social message of प्रेमचंद’s फटे जूते?

options.A: Society should judge individuals solely on their external appearance.
options.B: True worth lies in simplicity and honesty, not in material show.
options.C: Poverty is inevitable and must be accepted without question.
options.D: Education is unnecessary for the poor.

mcqs.answer: True worth lies in simplicity and honesty, not in material show.
mcqs.explanation: The story’s satire conveys that genuine value comes from inner simplicity and integrity, not from outward display of wealth. Options A, C, and D either invert the message or introduce unrelated ideas.

mcqs.question: Which characteristic is NOT typical of व्यंग्य as used by प्रेमचंद in फटे जूते?

options.A: Use of irony to expose hypocrisy.
options.B: Exaggeration of traits to highlight absurdity.
options.C: Direct praise without any critical undertone.

mcqs.answer: Direct praise without any critical undertone.
mcqs.explanation: व्यंग्य relies on irony, exaggeration, and contrast to critique; offering unqualified praise (option C) contradicts the very nature of satire. The other options describe genuine features of प्रेमचंद’s व्यंग्य.

mcqs.learning_point: प्रेमचंद के व्यक्तित्व के संदर्भ को समझना
mcqs.question: Which aspect of प्रेमचंद’s personal outlook is reflected in his portrayal of simplicity in फटे जूते?

options.A: His belief that material wealth defines moral superiority.
options.B: His advocacy for social equality and empathy towards the poor.

mcqs.answer: His advocacy for social equality and empathy towards the poor.
mcqs.explanation: प्रेमचंद was known for championing the downtrodden; the story’s emphasis on inner worth over outward show mirrors his commitment to equality. Options A, C, and D misrepresent his literary stance.

mcqs.learning_point: सादगी और दिखावे के अंतर को समझना
mcqs.question: How can सादगी be distinguished from दिखावा according to प्रेमचंद’s narrative?

options.A: सादगी is outward display of wealth, while दिखावा is modest behavior.
options.B: सादगी is inner humility regardless of external looks; दिखावा is outward pretence of importance.
options.C: Both terms mean the same and are interchangeable.
options.D: सादगी refers only to clothing, दिखावा to speech.

mcqs.answer: सादगी is inner humility regardless of external looks; दिखावा is outward pretence of importance.
mcqs.explanation: Option B captures the core distinction: सादगी denotes genuine modesty, whereas दिखावा denotes a false show of status. The other options either reverse the meanings or oversimplify them.

mcqs.learning_point: लेखक के व्यंग्यात्मक दृष्टिकोण को पहचानना
mcqs.question: A student writes an essay describing how societal pressure forces people to hide their true selves. Which element shows they have recognized प्रेमचंद’s व्यंग्यात्मक दृष्टिकोण?

options.B: Highlighting the contrast between worn shoes and the pride of the wearer, showing irony.
options.D: Praising the show of wealth as ideal.

mcqs.answer: Highlighting the contrast between worn shoes and the pride of the wearer, showing irony.
mcqs.explanation: Option B reflects the ironic contrast that प्रेमचंद uses to satirize societal pretence. The other options either miss the satirical angle or contradict it.
